metadata.title: Docetaxel / Cyclophosphamide (TC) Therapy – 21 day
metadata.indication: Adjuvant high-risk node-positive or node-negative operable breast cancer
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP source and boundary cases reviewed; not clinical validation or authorisation.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Source hepatic / boundary ambiguities are explicit review actions.
Independent clinical and pharmacy validation pending.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.

ongoing: FBC/renal/liver as clinically indicated per source; pre-cycle checks may be described as local chemotherapy workflow.
source_monitoring.imaging: No universal echo/ECG/DXA requirement. Adjuvant follow-up and other-agent surveillance by clinical plan.

metadata.schedule_summary: Docetaxel and cyclophosphamide on Day 1 every 21 days for four to six cycles. The team confirms the planned course before treatment. Radiotherapy, when indicated, follows chemotherapy.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.
